name: normal-ui
description: Normal UI: the browser's own stylesheet, repaired to WCAG 2.2 AA. Astro + React + StyleX.

scripts.dev: pnpm tokens && pnpm run build:react && pnpm --filter docs run dev
scripts.build: pnpm tokens && pnpm run build:react && pnpm --filter docs run build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-stylex.test.mjs scripts/stylelint-good-css.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @imsus/normal-ui-css run test
